note: AUTHORED SYNTHETIC FIXTURES. They are not recorded incidents: they describe inputs a test can build to reproduce a software behaviour. Real observed incidents are the sanitized aggregates in the other reports.

cases.title: IRT market SELL answers HTTP 404
cases.expected: The rejection is recorded as one deduplicated API_NETWORK error, the cycle continues, and no retry loop exceeds the configured backoff.
cases.assertion: Reproduce with a unit/integration test and assert the stated behaviour; never against a live account.

cases.title: Order below the exchange minimum is rejected
cases.expected: The local size gate refuses the order before submission (no network call) and records MIN_ORDER once.
cases.assertion: Reproduce with a unit/integration test and assert the stated behaviour; never against a live account.

cases.title: Sizing uses a stale free balance
cases.expected: The rejection is classified INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE and the wallet is re-synced before the next sizing decision.
cases.assertion: Reproduce with a unit/integration test and assert the stated behaviour; never against a live account.

cases.title: Fill price exceeds the slippage budget
cases.expected: A 120 bps deviation is refused or closed by the plan; the attempt is recorded with the relative deviation only.
cases.assertion: Reproduce with a unit/integration test and assert the stated behaviour; never against a live account.

cases.title: Order fills partially and the remainder is left resting
cases.expected: The unfilled remainder is tracked explicitly (chase or cancel), and the attempt carries a 0.4 fill ratio.
cases.assertion: Reproduce with a unit/integration test and assert the stated behaviour; never against a live account.

cases.title: Duplicate client order id is rejected by the exchange
cases.expected: The second submission is refused locally before reaching the exchange; one INVALID_ORDER record at most.
cases.assertion: Reproduce with a unit/integration test and assert the stated behaviour; never against a live account.

cases.title: AI endpoint times out mid-cycle
cases.expected: The cycle falls back to the deterministic heuristic, records one AI warning with no key material, and trading continues.
cases.assertion: Reproduce with a unit/integration test and assert the stated behaviour; never against a live account.

cases.title: Candle store returns no frames for a market
cases.expected: The market is skipped as DATA_QUALITY (not traded), and the signal records the data age or the empty response.
cases.assertion: Reproduce with a unit/integration test and assert the stated behaviour; never against a live account.

cases.title: IRT buy is funded with USDT-only cash
cases.expected: The buy is blocked: sections stay independent unless the interaction setting explicitly allows a transfer.
cases.assertion: Reproduce with a unit/integration test and assert the stated behaviour; never against a live account.

cases.title: SQLite reports 'database is locked'
cases.expected: The write retries within the busy timeout, then records one DATABASE error and drops the record instead of stalling a trading thread.
cases.assertion: Reproduce with a unit/integration test and assert the stated behaviour; never against a live account.

cases.title: Export pipeline sees a credential-shaped value
cases.expected: The value is redacted, the path becomes a base name, and the export aborts instead of writing if validation still finds a secret.
cases.assertion: Reproduce with a unit/integration test and assert the stated behaviour; never against a live account.
